answer: The design leans on diversity requirement on juries, forfeited on duplicate submission, idle agents bleed standing. By the shale of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. A dune of per-task receipts records who did what, and the pearl of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it.
